## The problem
I'm trying to take a picture snapshot of my Axis cameras when there is motion and nobody is home.
The problem is that I keep getting an error when the snapshot is taken.

<!--

-->

-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.109.1
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): Not known
- Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): Home Assistant
- Integration causing this issue: Axis
- Link to integration documentation on our website: 

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
homeassistant:
  customize: !include customize.yaml
  customize_glob: !include customize_glob.yaml
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
  whitelist_external_dirs:
    - /config/www/snapshots
```
In NodeRed I use the camera.snapshot function with this path:
{"filename":"/config/www/snapshots/camera_oprit.jpg"}

comments: Can you reproduce this without node red?

Hey there @kane610, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`axis`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L50) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

> Can you reproduce this without node red?

Hi Kane,

Thank you for your fast answer again! When I use the Call-Service in HA, I get the same error.

When I try the same with my Ring Camera, it works. It seems te be an issue with high resolution cameras.

Ok, if its an issue with high resolution I will not look into this issue quite yet. I have a couple of UniFi stuff left to clean up before I take my focus on improving the Axis integration. I will make resolution and other stuff configurable
This has been solved by https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/36322 (forgot to tagit earlier)
Try it out and get back to me. Closing this for now.

review_comments: It would be good if axis would implement its own camera interface in a library so we don't depend on the mjpeg camera platform here. That's not according to our standards.
Ok. Didn't know that. 2.5 year old code :).Do you have an example I can reference?
Since axis is using the mjpeg camera you could just take the parts that you use (digest authentication) from that platform and put in a library.
Great, I will do that for a future PR
